recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-shot portrait of a man with dark hair and tan skin, wearing a blue velvet blazer and plaid pants, seated in a domestic setting filled with framed family photos. The image is framed by a thick white inner border and a wide grey outer margin containing high-contrast serif text at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a busy, personal background
High-contrast blue velvet against warm terracotta and wood tones
Symmetrical typographic placement flanking the subject's head
Framed-within-a-frame composition using a white border
coreInvariants: Thin white inner frame around the photograph
High-contrast serif typography in the top margin
1970s fashion styling including wide lapels and velvet textures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, subject occupies the lower two-thirds of the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and direct gaze, framed by the dark hair and blue collar.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, moves down to the clasped hands, then outward to the background photos, and finally up to the text in the margins.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The grey outer margin serves as the primary negative space, providing a neutral buffer for the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy blue (velvet blazer) and terracotta (sofa pattern).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Neutral grey (outer border) and crisp white (inner frame).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Green and red plaid (trousers) and muted wood tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the clothing contrasted against a desaturated, neutral border system.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or modern digital colors
Stick to 1970s earth tones and jewel tones

letterConstructionRules: Significant stroke contrast between thicks and thins
Ball terminals on lowercase letters like 'g' and 'f'
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight kerning where characters almost touch

composition.position: Top left and top right corners of the grey margin

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used for both name and title for consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: A standard alternative with similar sharp serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1970s style photograph of a man in a blue velvet blazer and plaid pants sitting on a patterned sofa, surrounded by framed photos. Place this image inside a white border, which is then placed inside a larger grey square border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add high-contrast black serif text in the top-left and top-right corners of the grey margin.

verificationChecks: Is the outer border a flat neutral grey?
Is there a thin white line separating the photo from the grey?
Is the text a high-contrast serif?
Does the clothing have a visible velvet texture?

adjustableVariables: Specific text content in the margins
mustRedesign: Specific family photos in the background

mustAchieve: Authentic 1970s film grain and color grading

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is perfectly horizontal and aligned to the top corners.
Check that the white border is uniform on all four sides.
Verify the velvet texture looks tactile and rich.
Confirm the background elements are slightly out of focus compared to the subject.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered 70s-style portrait with a multi-layered border system (Neutral Outer / White Inner) and corner-aligned high-contrast serif typography.
